audit_items.proof_trace: Both `FlashLoan` (market.move:39-42) and its inner `ReserveFlashLoan` (reserve.move:33-35) declare no abilities (`drop`, `store`, `copy`, `key` all absent), which is enforced at bytecode verification level by the Move VM — any transaction leaving a live `FlashLoan` unconsumed or attempting to store it will be rejected before execution. The only structural consumer is `repay_flash_loan` (market.move:836), which destructures the value; no external module can bypass this because fields are module-private.
